$comment: Every string a person reads. The harness prefixes displayed lines with the event name, so each of these has to read naturally after 'Stop says:' and never open by restating the situation. A key nothing references is removed rather than kept for later: an unused message is a message nobody has read in context.
canary.broken: The protections on this project are not answering on this computer. I can keep going without them, but say "repair the protections" and I will sort it out.
gate.blocked.one: I am carrying on: {count} thing is left before I can hand this over.
gate.blocked.other: I am carrying on: {count} things are left before I can hand this over.
gate.stuck: The same things are still outstanding after three attempts, so I am stopping rather than going round again. The list is in {path}.
gate.spent: I have asked three times already, so I am letting this go rather than pressing. What is left is in {path}.
gate.needs_you.one: One thing needs you rather than me: {first}.
gate.needs_you.other: {count} things need you rather than me, starting with {first}.
gate.not_looked.one: This turn is clean, though one thing could not be checked here; it is listed in {path}.
gate.not_looked.other: This turn is clean, though {count} things could not be checked here; they are listed in {path}.
ledger.cannot_note: I could not write down that this turn is changing the project, so nothing would check the result afterwards. I have left the file alone.
secrets.withheld_write: I stopped a password from being written in plain text where it would be published. I am putting it in a private file instead.
secrets.withheld_read: I did not open that file: it holds private keys, and anything I read from it ends up in this conversation.
secrets.cannot_check: I could not check whether that file holds anything private, so I left it alone.
snapshot.failed: I could not take a safety copy first, so I am not running that command. Nothing has been changed.
snapshot.no_repository: There is no version history here yet, so I have nothing to fall back on if that command goes wrong. Let me set one up first.
snapshot.no_ignore_rules: This project has no ignore rules yet, so a safety copy would sweep up every generated file. Let me add them first, then run that command.
status.all_clear: Nothing is outstanding that I can act on.
status.nothing_skipped: Nothing was skipped in this pass.
status.full_report: The full report from the last pass is at `{path}`.
